jobs.description: Ipsos Ipsos is one of the world's largest research companies and currently the only one primarily managed by researchers, ranking as a #1 full-service research organization for four consecutive years. With over 75 different data-driven solutions, and presence in 90 markets, Ipsos brings together research, implementation, methodological, and subject-matter experts from around the world, combining thematic and technical experts to deliver top-quality research and insights. Simply speaking, we help the biggest companies solve some of their biggest problems, serving more than 5000 clients across the globe by providing research, data, and insights on their target markets. Ipsos Healthcare is the world's leading provider of quantitative and qualitative market research studies in the pharmaceutical and medical technology sectors. The focus is on doctors, medical professionals, and, above all, patients. Our range of solutions is very diverse and covers traditional primary market research as well as scientific Real-World Evidence studies. In collaboration with our national and international clients, we conduct studies along the entire lifecycle of a healthcare product, from early demand and quality-of-life studies to projects for the preparation and accompaniment of product launches (including success measurements) and studies that help already launched products or approved preparations achieve greater success. We are looking for a Senior Insights Consultant (f/m/d) for our Healthcare team at one of our locations in Hamburg, Berlin, Frankfurt, Nuremberg or Munich. Your role You will be part of a team managing a multi-national big tracking program, managing local clients and global stakeholders. After your onboarding time, you will be responsible for leading the project setup & design, the client conversations and the team (functionally) for one of the product categories. You accompany and manage quantitative market research projects from conception to delivery on a national and international level. You support the consulting of clients regarding project design and methodological questions. You independently create proposals and calculations for study designs. You handle the coordination of project phases and work closely with internal interfaces as well as external service providers. You analyze study results, create meaningful reports, and present the results confidently to clients. You actively participate in the creation of pitch presentations and the expansion of existing client relationships. You work cross-departmentally within Ipsos Germany and maintain close exchange with global and European healthcare teams. Your profile You hold a university degree, preferably in business administration (focus on marketing/market research), social sciences, psychology, communication science, health science/public health, or a comparable field. You have 2-3 years of relevant experience in market research (institute or client side), ideally in healthcare, pharma, or medical technology. You have excellent knowledge of quantitative and qualitative research methodologies, as well as strong understanding of advanced analytical techniques - but focus on recommending the right approaches and clearly explaining results, implications, and limitations to non-technical stakeholders rather than running analyses yourself. You demonstrate strong client management, communication, and storytelling skills, combined with analytical thinking and organizational strength. You are experienced in using modern project management tools and approaches. You are fluent in English; good level of German is preferred. You are open-minded, innovation-driven, and motivated to improve processes and efficiencies. You approach challenges with a proactive and confident mindset, navigating complex and unfamiliar situations effectively. You are a team player with flexibility and creativity. You have very good IT user skills, particularly in Office 365. What we offer At Ipsos, you can expect an international and innovative working environment. We serve renowned clients across almost all major industries and work on exciting projects worldwide! You can look forward to: Hybrid work Flexible working hours Workation in European countries Ipsos Corporate Benefits Subsidy for the Germany public transport ticket (Deutschlandticket) Job rotation opportunities Development & learning culture International collaboration Events & local community Diversity & inclusion initiatives Corporate social responsibility programs Modern workplace Interested? Apply now! We look forward to receiving your application (CV, certificates, and optional a short cover letter) including your earliest possible start date and salary expectations. jobs.occupation: Optical Architect (d/f/m) for Optical Instruments (DevOps Engineer)
jobs.description:
About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

In order to support Earth Observation & Science projects within Space Systems, Airbus Defence and Space in Ottobrunn is looking for an

Optical Architect (d/f/m)

You will join a multicultural team of engineers specialized in the development of optical (sub-)systems working for Earth Observation & Science projects within Space Systems. These developments cover instruments for ESA, CNES, DLR and EU programmes across the spectral range from ultraviolet to thermal infrared. Examples include LIDARs (ATLID, MERLIN), Multi-Spectral Instruments (Sentinel-2 MSI, Sentinel-4, Sentinel-5) from the Copernicus programme, infrared instruments (LSTM, TRISHNA), meteorological instruments (IASI-NG and METimage) embarked on MetOp-SG, instruments for scientific missions like EUCLID, cameras embarked on LEO and GEO satellites, and national programmes.

This role is also available with reduced weekly hours and an adapted scope of tasks.

Your location

Our site is just a stone's throw away from Munich, the beautiful capital of Bavaria.

Are you into sports and other outdoor activities? The Alps and Lake Starnberg are within an hour’s reach, offering a multitude of recreational options.

Our Benefits for You

- Fair Compensation & Extras: Attractive remuneration and individual additional benefits, such as company pension schemes, mobility offers (e.g., bike leasing), or corporate discounts with partner companies in accordance with our current guidelines.
- Time for You (and Your Loved Ones): 30 days of annual leave based on our collective agreement (35-hour week); work-life balance through flexible working hours (flextime), mobile working, part-time options, job sharing, and sabbatical opportunities.
- Growth Made Easy: Excellent professional development opportunities and international, group-wide career perspectives.
- Feel Good at Work: On-site company doctor; comprehensive health programs (sports courses, preventive care, etc.), canteen and cafeteria, and local childcare facilities at selected locations.
- Diversity Connects: Work in a diverse environment with more than 140 nationalities, where exchange, mutual support, and inclusion are part of our DNA.

Your tasks and responsibilities

- Define and develop optical subsystem architecture and verification strategies for space-borne instruments in project phases B2, C, and D following defined processes.
- Act as the main technical contact point for optical domain matters, supporting systems engineers on technological, design, verification, risk, cost, and schedule aspects.
- Perform optical design and analysis, including stray light analysis, optical layout, tolerances, and stray light, thermal, and optical performance (STOP) budget allocations.
- Coordinate optical subsystem engineering and Assembly, Integration, and Testing (AIT) activities across multidisciplinary teams (Mechanical, Thermal, Electrical, Detection-chain, Cleanliness).
- Derive, consolidate, and maintain optical subsystem requirements in alignment with higher-level specifications (e.g., SRD, IRD) and verification plans.
- Oversee subcontracted optical equipment procurement, reviewing data packages and test plans to ensure on-time, on-cost, and on-quality delivery.
- Contribute to future programmes (phase 0 or A/B1), support internal/external R&D proposals for new optical technologies, and participate in lessons-learnt exchanges.

Desired skills and qualifications

- Master's degree or PhD in Physics, Optical Engineering
- Proven multi-year experience in optical instrumentation or optical sensors, ideally for space applications
- Solid experience in optical layout, design, tolerance, and STOP analysis, including maintenance of optical allocations/budgets.
- Proficiency with commercial optical design software (e.g., Code V, Zemax, FRED) and programming languages (e.g., Matlab, Python).
- Sound technical knowledge of optical components (e.g., mirrors, photonics, gratings, fibers, lasers, coatings) and space equipment alignment/testing strategies.
- Strong communication skills, collaborative problem-solving approach, and experience in managing suppliers or subcontractors.
- Professional working proficiency in English; knowledge of German is beneficial.

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions.

Take your career to a new level and apply online now!

This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth

By submitting your CV or application you are consenting to Airbus using and storing information about you for monitoring purposes relating to your application or future employment. This information will only be used by Airbus.
Airbus is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.

At Airbus, we support you to work, connect and collaborate more easily and flexibly. Wherever possible, we foster flexible working arrangements to stimulate innovative thinking.

jobs.description:
Go beyond and create global impact: At Munich Re, we're proud to be one of the world's leading providers of reinsurance, primary insurance, and insurance-related risk solutions. Our group is made up of the reinsurance and ERGO business segments, along with our asset management company, MEAG. We operate globally and are active in all lines of the insurance business.
Since our founding in 1880, we've built a reputation for unrivalled risk-related expertise and a solid financial foundation. We use our strengths to support our clients' business goals and drive technological progress. We're also at the forefront of developing coverage for emerging risks, from rocket launches and renewable energy to cyber threats and artificial intelligence.
With around 44,000 people worldwide, our group's corporate culture is defined by performance, mutual respect, and trust. All this makes us an attractive employer providing global career development opportunities and prospects.
Munich Re's Facultative and Corporate business unit (MR F&C) manages our global facultative reinsurance and direct insurance portfolio across Property, Engineering, Energy, Casualty, Cyber, and New Risk Solutions. Since 2019, MR F&C has grown significantly and invested in innovative initiatives. - Experience in (re)insurance, particularly underwriting products, processes, and markets, is a plus.
- Strong analytical and conceptual skills, with the ability to simplify complexity, make sound decisions, and communicate clearly across cultures and seniority levels.
- Proficiency in agile methods and tools; experience with backlog and test management tools.

Our group is made up of the reinsurance and ERGO business segments, along with our asset management company, MEAG. We operate globally and are active in all lines of the insurance business.
Since our founding in 1880, we've built a reputation for unrivalled risk-related expertise and a solid financial foundation. We use our strengths to support our clients' business goals and drive technological progress. We're also at the forefront of developing coverage for emerging risks, from rocket launches and renewable energy to cyber threats and artificial intelligence.
With around 44,000 people worldwide, our group's corporate culture is defined by performance, mutual respect, and trust. All this makes us an attractive employer providing global career development opportunities and prospects.
Credit risks are the main underwriting focus in EULA5. The Global Credit Solutions (GCS) team is writing business mainly with global banks by insuring credit risks originated by the banks, where the team assumes the role of a primary insurer. Your task as a Client Relation Risk Manager is to attract new bank clients, manage existing bank clients and writing proactive business within your responsibility. It is necessary to meet credit decision in conjunction with the Risk Underwriting (RUW).
Your Job

- Developing our global business by binding new transactions with new and existing clients
- Establish new and foster existing client relationships, with focus on the global banks. Identify the relevant people within these organisations and establish a personal relationship
- Negotiation and finalizing of insurance policies and Master Risk Participation Agreements with the global banks
- Own risk assessments of the transactions offered by the banks, especially in the area of trade finance
- Assessment of the banks capabilities in originating and assessing credit risks in all relevant trade finance products

Your Profile

- University degree, preferably in business or economics, or equivalent training (banking traineeship followed by relevant further education)
- Several years' professional experience within a bank or professional experience in the risk transfer market between banks and insurance companies in the field of Global Trade Finance
- Proven track record in originating, structuring and closing trade finance and credit risk transactions directly with banks and/or corporates, combined with a demonstrated ability to generate new business opportunities and build long-term strategic client relationships across international markets
- Several years of professional experience in client management and the acquisition and development of international banking and corporate clients
- Strong business development capabilities, including the ability to identify new market opportunities, expand market presence and establish strategic partnerships in key trade finance markets
- Demonstrated experience in establishing, developing and scaling new business areas, products, platforms or market initiatives, ideally in an international environment
- Deep understanding of global trade finance products, risk mitigation structures and relevant international markets
- Strong commercial mindset combined with sound risk assessment capabilities, relationship management skills and the ability to successfully execute complex transactions
- Superior analytical skills in conjunction with a pronounced risk awareness and sense of responsibility, along with a willingness and ability to justify decisions in a clear and comprehensible manner
- Team-oriented, entrepreneurial and solution-driven personality with a high degree of initiative and the ability to work independently
- Business-level English required; additional excellent foreign-language skills an advantage
- Confident manner, high degree of social skills when interacting with colleagues, clients or in-house interfaces

Application Instructions
Please apply through our online portal and upload your CV, as well as your academic reference letters, including school certificates, graduation certificates and transcripts of record for any degrees. If applicable, please also submit reference letters from any previous employers or certificates from any other qualifications you may have. We recommend writing a cover letter to tell us more about why the position and Munich Re is of interest to you.
About us
As the world's leading reinsurance company with more than 16,000 employees at over 50 locations, Munich Re introduces a paradigm shift in the way you think about insurance. By turning uncertainty into a manageable risk we enable fundamental change. Join us working on topics today that will concern society tomorrow, whether that be climate change, major construction projects, medical risk assessment or even space travel.
Together we embrace a culture where multiskilled teams dare to think big. We create the new and the different for our clients and cultivate innovation.
Sounds like you? Push boundaries with us and be part of Munich Re.
Our employees are our greatest strength. That's why we offer them a wide range of benefits. You can find some examples below.
Unlock your potential

- Diversity, Equity & Inclusion: we embrace the power of differences and are convinced that diversity fosters innovation and resilience and enables us to act braver and better.
- Continuous Learning: we believe that continuous learning is a key differentiator and critical for building new skills and accelerating growth.
- Career Mobility: we actively support career mobility, and our strong global and regional presence offers a wealth of career growth opportunities for you.

Rewards & Recognition

- Competitive salary: appropriate compensation for your high level of commitment.
- Retirement provision: state of the art in-house pension solutions.
- Work-life balance: promoting the compatibility of family and work in addition to overall work-life balance.
- Health management: focus on your physical and mental health far beyond legal requirements.
- Hybrid working: living the best of both worlds - we offer you a very flexible approach as well as the opportunity to work from abroad on an occasional basis.
- Munich Re not only stands for fairness with regard to its clients; it is also an equal opportunities employer. Severely disabled candidates will also be prioritized, if equally qualified.
Münchener Rückversicherungs-Gesellschaft
Leonie Johnson
Talent Acquisition Partner

WHAT WE DO - AND WHY
FEV Consulting is the FEV Group's technology-driven top management consultancy. We act as a guide between strategy development and product realization in today's global environment. We do not simply work for companies, but for our customers - people who want to move society forward. That's why we develop and optimize technical product concepts with our focus on customer benefit, feasibility, sustainability and profitability.

We are looking for committed team players. Together with us and our customers, you will actively shape the future of mobility and the energy industry. You can expect a varied and exciting working day filled with challenging questions to tackle. You will be joining a strong, collaborative team and will benefit from our international and interdisciplinary environment.
You provide support on technical and strategic tasks in interdisciplinary teams of consultants and technical specialists
Your daily tasks include the analysis and evaluation of complex issues
You create management-ready presentations of results
You take over the planning and preparation of expert interviews and workshops and actively participate in them
You support our working students in their personal development

You are interested in innovative products and future technologies and have a passion for sustainable mobility and energy
You have completed your studies at a top university with exceptional achievements and impress us with your personal profile
Ideally, you have already had initial practical experience in management consulting or a technical industry
In addition to your excellent analytical and conceptual skills, you have a high level of creativity
You enjoy working independently on projects and driving them forward as part of a team
You communicate fluently in both English and German and possess intercultural experience
You identify with our company values - customer focus, professionalism, commitment, open-mindedness and respect

jobs.occupation: #ET20R Ground Test on HC (d/f/m) (Testingenieur/in)
jobs.description:
About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

**Ground Test Engineer (d/f/m) - Engineering Ground Test on Aircraft **

You will join the Ground Test team, which is part of the Flight Test Center of AIRBUS Helicopters Germany. Our team performs development, certification, and qualification testing activities on aircraft on ground. It comprises the domains electromagnetic compatibility (EMC), avionics and vehicle mission systems, vibrations, and acoustics.
Our main goal is to ensure system maturity for by making the bridge between avionic/vehicle rigs and flight tests. In order to do that we optimize integration and test sequence in close relationship with design office, simulation, rigs, flight-test crews, and prototype shops. Finally, we show compliance with regulations specifications or certification/qualification requirements, in order to get our aircraft certified.

Your location:

At our Donauwörth site, located on the banks of the river Danube, we develop helicopters from the initial idea to the airworthy product. Watch them take off and touch down on our own on-site test airfield.

Your benefits:

- Attractive salary including holiday pay, Christmas bonus and profit sharing
- 30 days holidays and extra days-off for special occasions
- Excellent upskilling opportunities and great development prospects
- Special benefits: employer-funded pension, employee stock options, discounted car leasing, special conditions for insurances, public transport subsidy, discounts at local businesses, and further additional company benefits such as Job Bike and Wellpass
- On-site-facilities: medical officer for check-ups and other health-related services, canteens and cafeterias

Your tasks and responsibilities:

- Organizing, preparing, and performing ground test activities on various helicopters of the AIRBUS Helicopters fleet (development and certification) with related interfaces (Chief Engineering/Project, Prototype Shop, Design department or Helicopter Test Coordinator/Test Squad Leader)
- Being responsible for ground test activities mainly for EMC, and in addition for vibration and acoustic tests for civil and military platforms
- Analyzing and validating the test data with immediate debriefing and report before the flight tests
- Writing of technical reports and follow up of respective problem analysis
- Supporting to aircraft troubleshooting and ensuring testing expertise
- Following technological evolution for new systems, functions, testing tools and means

Desired skills and qualifications:

- Engineering degree in mechatronics / electrical engineering / communications engineering or technical degree (e.g. completed technical vocational training and Technikerschule)
- Capability to undergo a Sicherheitsüberprüfung, at minimum Ü2
- At least 5–10 years of professional experience in a technically relevant area of electrical or communications engineering, design, development or a similar field
- Strong interest or experience in avionic systems, radios, test or simulation tools is an advantage
- Innovative thinking, tenacity, adaptability, flexibility, and teamwork skills
- Very good analysis and excellent communication skills
- High resilience and ability to work in a daily changing and highly dynamic environment
- Language skills: Fluent in German and English.

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth with customized development solutions.

** Take your career to a new level and apply online (https://www.airbus.com/en/careers) now!**

jobs.description:
About us

Airbus pioneers sustainable aerospace for a safe and united world. The Company constantly innovates to provide efficient and technologically-advanced solutions in aerospace, defence, and connected services. In commercial aircraft, Airbus offers modern and fuel-efficient airliners and associated services. Airbus is also a European leader in defence and security and one of the world's leading space businesses. In helicopters, Airbus provides the most efficient civil and military rotorcraft solutions and services worldwide.
Job description

The A400M is a versatile European tactical airlifter that bridges the gap between traditional transport aircraft and strategic airlift capabilities. It stands as a symbol of industrial excellence and collaborative defense capability.

Be part of this journey and join our team to shape the future of A400M simulation! We develop advanced simulation software for the A400M programme, ranging from high-fidelity Full Flight Simulators (FFS) for pilot training to advanced test facilities for avionics integration and certification. We support the A400M Military Test and Support Facility (MTSF) by providing simulation models that enable the verification and certification of avionics at software, equipment, and system levels. Our work ensures that aircraft updates are accurately represented in both training and test environments, utilizing a tech stack centered on C/C++.

As a Junior Software Engineer in our MTSF team, you will be responsible for the full lifecycle of simulation solutions. You will translate high‑level operational and system requirements from a variety of stakeholders into robust simulation models, design and define the necessary simulation interfaces, develop and test complex models, and drive the successful release and deployment of those models. Throughout the process you will guarantee high‑quality delivery and provide support during customer‑acceptance activities.

Located about an hour’s drive north of Munich, Manching is an up-and-coming market town that offers a wide range of leisure and cultural activities. Here, you can enjoy the quality of life in the countryside while the pleasures of near-by cities are still within easy reach.

- Working internationally gives you the opportunity to travel occasionally to meet partners on‑site.

jobs.occupation: Transformation and Change Management Specialist (f/m/d) (Einkäufer/in)
jobs.employer_name: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

As a Transformation and Change Management (f/m/d) Specialist, you will work at the intersection of business transformation, AI deployment, and organizational change. On any given day, you may align with business leaders on upcoming AI rollouts, develop strategies to increase adoption of new digital solutions, coach stakeholders through change, and collaborate with Industrialized Rollout teams to ensure transformation activities are seamlessly integrated into deployment plans. You will monitor adoption trends, identify risks and barriers, and translate insights into actionable recommendations that accelerate business value realization. A key part of your role will be establishing scalable change management standards, tools, and governance approaches that enable consistent execution across multiple transformation initiatives. Ultimately, you will help ensure that AI-driven change is not only deployed successfully, but embraced, embedded, and sustained across Procurement.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Leadership of the people and organizational aspects of AI-enabled transformation initiatives, ensuring sustainable adoption of new ways of working
* Development and execution of change strategies to drive business readiness, stakeholder alignment, and behavioral change
* Establishment and continuous improvement of a standardized change management framework, including tools, governance, and success measures
* Integration of change management activities into deployment plans in collaboration with rollout leads, business leaders, and AI product teams
* Definition and monitoring of adoption metrics, business readiness, user adoption, risks, and value realization across rollout waves
* Identification of adoption barriers, consolidation of lessons learned, and implementation of continuous improvement measures to maximize transformation outcomes

What You Bring

* Master’s degree in Business, Supply Chain Management, Organizational Development, or a similar field
* Extensive experience in Change Management, Business Transformation, Organizational Development, or Digital Transformation, including IT tool implementations such as SAP Ariba or Workday
* Proven track record in leading large-scale transformation programs across functions, regions, and business units, including organizational and cultural transformation
* Demonstrated experience in driving adoption of new technologies, digital solutions, and automation initiatives, including the development of training and communication materials
* Strong expertise in senior stakeholder management, organizational change, operating model transformation, and business process improvement, ideally within a consulting environment
* Fluent in German and English (C2 level)

About the Team

You will join an Organization and Workforce Transformation team within Procurement that combines strategy and execution. We design future‑oriented concepts, but we also take responsibility for making them work in practice. Collaboration, trust, and a strong sense of ownership define how we work together. If you enjoy building something meaningful with real impact, you will feel at home here.

Who is Siemens Energy? 

At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      

Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo

Our Commitment to Diversity 

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. 

Rewards/Benefits 

* In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme
* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder
* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity
* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose
* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical

We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.

jobs.occupation: Senior Software Engineer – Flash (f/m/d) (Softwareentwickler/in)
jobs.description:
About Us

What if your work could drive change in a globally established industry, shaping processes that touch every corner of the world? At Forto, we are at the forefront of change, harnessing the power of AI to revolutionise logistics. We want to reinvent digital supply chains to be transparent, frictionless and sustainable. From day one, our mission has been to simplify global trade – creating a seamless and efficient logistics process.

Your Role & Mission

The mission of the Flash team at Forto is to fundamentally redesign operations processes by leveraging automation and intelligent decision-making to handle shipments more efficiently. We aim to scale CoPilot so that it becomes the primary system used by operations managers, enabling them to be more effective and efficient in their daily work.

As a Senior Software Engineer in the Flash team, you will help build AI-driven solutions and the CoPilot that powers our logistics operations. You will maintain and evolve a sophisticated event-driven, distributed architecture designed to answer one key question:

How do we improve shipment handling and bring efficiency to our operations teams at scale?

From quotation and rate management, to shipment execution and schedule optimization (capacity utilization and GP optimization), to carrier integrations and automated data extraction from unstructured sources (emails, PDFs, spreadsheets), this role focuses on building reliable, data-heavy systems that directly impact revenue and operational performance.

What you will do

- Design, build, and evolve scalable and resilient backend systems
- Contribute to an event-driven, distributed architecture
- Work on AI-adjacent systems (integration, orchestration, data-heavy workflows)
- Own services end-to-end (design, implementation, documentation, operation)
- Collaborate closely with product managers, operations, and other engineers
- Communicate clearly with stakeholders and explain technical trade-offs
- Contribute to technical standards and best practices within the team
- Foster a culture of excellence by coaching team members in best practices for backend engineering, domain-driven design, and navigating the complexities of the logistics domain.

Required Skills and Experience

- Strong grasp of data structures, algorithms, and complexity analysis, particularly as they apply to large-scale data processing and financial calculations.
- Proven professional software craftsmanship, with a focus on building high-quality, maintainable, and testable code (an understanding of TDD is a plus).
- Expertise in designing and implementing large-scale, event-driven microservices architectures and robust APIs, with a keen understanding of data consistency in distributed systems.
- Deep understanding of synchronous vs. asynchronous communication patterns and their impact on system performance and reliability
- Hands-on experience developing distributed backend applications, with a strong focus on data consistency, system quality, low latency, and high availability.
- Proficiency in microservices, with hands-on experience in backend technologies such as Node.js, TypeScript, and MongoDB.
- Familiarity with Kubernetes and container orchestration for deploying and managing scalable pricing services.
- Experience with cloud providers (AWS or GCP preferred) for deploying and managing highly available and scalable applications.
- A collaborative, team-oriented mindset with strong critical product thinking and a sense of ownership over the accuracy and effectiveness of pricing data.
- Fluent in English, both verbal and written, for effective communication within a global team.

Preferred Skills and Experience

- Experience integrating AI/LLM-powered features into user faced applications
- Experience applying Domain-Driven Design (DDD) in complex product domains

Don’t fit all of our criteria? That’s okay! We know that you might be hesitant to apply if you don’t meet all our requirements, but here at Forto, we pride ourselves on embracing diverse perspectives and celebrating potential. If you are passionate about this position and the Forto values, please apply anyway. There could be a place for you in this role – or another one that’s a perfect fit! 

Why work with us?

Our team is hard-working, constantly seeking to maximise the impact of their work, but we put our people first, always winning with care. We value efficient systems and swift, direct communication. We want everyone to have their time to speak, so that we can embrace diverse perspectives to help drive towards solutions always.

jobs.occupation: First Officer A220 - type-rated or experienced on other types (permanent, all genders) (Chefpilot/in)
jobs.description:
As a First Officer, you are characterized by openness, professionalism and pragmatism. You are a team player and take responsibility for your decisions. You love flying and are keen to explore new and exciting routes in all parts of Europe. In addition...

- ... you operate the Lufthansa City Airlines aircraft safely and efficiently
- ... you act responsibly and sustainably
- ... you are ready and willing to actively shape Lufthansa City Airlines

Ihr Profil:

In addition to your strong decision-making skills and ability to work in a team, you will need the following for this vacancy:

- EASA CPL(A) / IR(A) with ATPL theory credit and MCC or MPL (Phase 4 completed)
- A320/A220 Type Rating and 500h total flight hours on CS-25 aircraft
- Medical Class I
- Advanced UPRT training according to EASA.FCL.745
- General higher education entrance qualification or equivalent qualification
- EU citizenship or unrestricted residence and work permit
- Passport with unlimited validity (if no EU passport is available, there must be no stricter entry restrictions than with an EU passport)
- Confident oral and written language skills in English (at least ICAO Language Proficiency Level 4)

Selection is based on the standards of City Airlines. Recognition of Lufthansa Group selection procedures is possible.

jobs.occupation: Senior Partner Development Manager – Distribution Partners Germany, EMEA Partner Organization (Betriebswirt/in - allgemeine Betriebswirtschaft)
jobs.employer_name: Amazon Web Services EMEA SARL Niederlassung Deutschland
jobs.description:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking an experienced Distribution Partner Development Manager to own and drive the AWS distribution strategy across Germany. In this role, you will manage and grow strategic relationships with our Authorised Distribution Partners such as Ingram Micro and TD Synnex, particularly for SMB and Enterprise customers. An additional area of responsibility is to grow the business with large value added resellers (“Systemhäuser”, e.g. Bechtle, Cancom) across Enterprise and Public Sector Accounts.

The AWS Distribution Program enables our distributors to act as force multipliers — leveraging their deep partner relationships, market knowledge, and specialised expertise to extend the reach of AWS solutions to customers we cannot efficiently serve through direct channels alone. This is a high-impact, high-visibility role that requires a rare blend of strategic thinking, commercial acumen, and operational discipline. You will not only execute on strategy — you will shape it, acting as the voice of distribution into AWS program design discussions and influencing worldwide policy decisions where distribution-specific considerations are required.

As the single-threaded owner of the German distribution channel, you will serve as the primary interface between AWS and our distributors, driving incremental revenue through their reseller communities. You will work cross-functionally with AWS sales, partner, marketing, and solutions architecture teams to accelerate cloud adoption at scale, particularly within the SMB Commercial Sector.

Key job responsibilities
Partner Management & Strategy
• Own end-to-end relationships with Authorised Distribution and Systemhaus Partners in Germany.
• Develop and execute joint business plans aligned to AWS go-to-market and EMEA strategy.
• Drive QBRs and cadence meetings with partner leadership at VP/CXO level.
• Grow distributor-attributed and AWS Marketplace revenue YoY.
• Pursue new routes-to-market and "Power of Three" collaboration.

Revenue & Performance Management
• Own revenue targets for the German channel, including resell and influenced revenue.
• Monitor distributor performance: revenue, recruitment, enablement, pipeline.
• Produce monthly partner reports from internal dashboards.
• Analyse trends, flag risks/opportunities, drive action plans.
• Track Partner Attributed Revenue and ensure accurate attribution.

Program Design & Execution
• Act as the voice of distribution into AWS program design discussions, representing field-level feedback on attribution models, incentive structures, and partner programs.
.
• Ensure distributors are enabled on launches and policy changes.

Enablement & Ecosystem Growth
• Recruit, onboard, and activate new resellers into the channel.
• Align with PDMs and Account Managers across direct, distribution, and "Power of Three" motions.
• Drive technical enablement (AI, Migration, Data & Analytics); support co-sell/co-marketing.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
• Align Germany execution with EMEA Scale & Distribution strategy.
• Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Partner Solutions Architects, Operations.

About the team
The Distribution team sits within the Amazon Partner Organisation in Germany & Europe Central, focused on extending AWS's reach through established distributor communities to serve the Commercial Sector at scale. You'll be part of a collaborative, high-performing team that values customer obsession, partner obsession, and execution excellence.

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- Experience developing strategies that influence leadership decisions at the organizational level
- Experience presenting to both technical and non-technical executive audiences
- Minimum 6 years of channel experience, with specific distribution, indirect channel or reselling background
- German and English business fluent
- Cloud and/or digital transformation experience — understanding of cloud business models, consumption economics, and partner ecosystems
- Proven ability to manage breadth over depth — portfolio management across 30+ partners through leverage and prioritisation
- Strong commercial acumen: pipeline management, forecasting, and revenue accountability
- Demonstrated stakeholder management across complex, matrixed organisations

Preferred Qualifications

- Direct experience with IT distribution (Ingram Micro, TD SYNNEX, Arrow, ALSO) or Systemhaus channel (Bechtle, Cancom, Computacenter)
- AWS or hyperscaler partner programme experience
- Experience with CRM systems and pipeline analytics (Salesforce preferred)
- Understanding of software marketplace transaction models and cloud procurement
- Track record of building new coverage models or channel motions from scratch
- Familiarity with German SMB and mid-market IT landscape

Amazon is an equal opportunities employer. We believe passionately that employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build.
